summary.title: Threat Model
summary.description: BestieAYG threat model — Level 0 context + Level 1 detailed DFD with expanded STRIDE threats. June 2026.

diagrams.title: Context Diagram (DFD level 0)

data.name: User
data.description: Primary actor

data.name: OpenWeather API
data.description: External - api.openweathermap.org (dashboard weather, API key)
data.reasonOutOfScope: External third-party service (openweathermap.org). We do not control or own this system. Only the data flows to/from it are in scope for threat modeling.

data.name: Park Open Source Data
data.description: External - Overpass/OSM
data.reasonOutOfScope: External open data source (OpenStreetMap / Overpass API). Publicly accessible, read-only. We do not control this system, only our consumption of it is in scope.

data.name: Android OS (Instagram usage)
data.description: On-device — UsageStatsManager + AccessibilityService for com.instagram.android. Not Instagram's network API.
data.reasonOutOfScope: Provided by the Android OS (UsageStatsManager). We do not control Instagram or the Android OS internals, only how our app reads and processes this data is in scope.

data.name: No-as-a-service
data.description: External - noasaservice.lol (sanitized dashboard quote)
data.reasonOutOfScope: External third-party API. We do not control or own this service. Only the data flow from this API into our app is in scope.

data.name: Android Local Calendar
data.description: On-device - Android CalendarContract
data.reasonOutOfScope: External service (calendar.google.com). We do not control Google's infrastructure. Only how our app requests and handles calendar event data is in scope.

data.name: Android App Usage Stats
data.description: Android OS - UsageStatsManager
data.reasonOutOfScope: Provided by the Android OS (UsageStatsManager API). We do not control the Android operating system, only how our app requests and stores usage data is in scope.

data.name: BestieAYG App
data.description: Android application (com.bayg). Dashboard, Touch Grass, stats, settings, auth.

threats.title: Repackaged APK removes Instagram blocker
threats.description: Attacker distributes modified APK without InstagramBlockerService or with raised usage limits.
threats.mitigation: Release signing; distribute via team channel; document integrity checks in security report.

threats.title: Sensitive local data read on rooted device
threats.description: Rooted user reads Room DB, logs, or memory containing usage stats and calendar-derived signals.
threats.mitigation: Minimize PII at rest; EncryptedSharedPreferences for flags; no passwords stored locally.

data.name: auth credentials
data.description: Email + password via app UI to Firebase Auth

threats.title: Phishing overlay on login screen
threats.description: Malicious app draws overlay mimicking Auth UI to harvest credentials.
threats.mitigation: Use system autofill where possible; educate users; FLAG_SECURE on auth screens (optional).

data.name: OpenWeather forecast
data.description: Current weather JSON for dashboard card (lat/lon + API key)

threats.title: OpenWeather API key extracted from APK
threats.description: BuildConfig.OPENWEATHER_API_KEY is embedded at compile time; strings/decompile reveals key.
threats.mitigation: Rate-limit key in OpenWeather dashboard; rotate if abused; proxy via backend (future).

threats.title: Spoofed weather response (MITM)
threats.description: Attacker returns fake JSON to manipulate dashboard weather nudge.
threats.mitigation: Certificate pinning for openweathermap.org in network_security_config.xml.

threats.title: Instagram usage metadata exposes behaviour
threats.description: UsageStatsManager reveals app-open duration; correlates with mental-health nudges.
threats.mitigation: PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS permission gated in UI; data stays on device except Firestore sync.

threats.title: Malicious HTML/JS in No-as-a-Service quote
threats.description: noasaservice.lol returns crafted payload with script tags or javascript: URIs shown on dashboard.
threats.mitigation: NoAsAMessageSanitizer strips tags, JS URIs, control chars; 500-char cap.

data.name: app UI / stats
data.description: Dashboard, stats charts, settings, Touch Grass screen

data.name: CBS StatLine
data.description: External - opendata.cbs.nl
data.reasonOutOfScope: External government open data service (opendata.cbs.nl). We do not control CBS's infrastructure or the accuracy of their published statistics. Only how our app fetches and displays the Dutch national average data is in scope.

data.name: Firebase (Auth + Firestore)
data.description: External - Google Firebase. Auth, email verification, Firestore profile/settings/streak sync.
data.reasonOutOfScope: External Google-managed cloud. We do not control Firebase infrastructure. Only our app's auth calls and Firestore sync paths are in scope.

data.name: Open-Meteo / Nominatim
data.description: External open data - api.open-meteo.com + nominatim.openstreetmap.org (Touch Grass weather + city)
data.reasonOutOfScope: External open-data APIs. No API key. We only control how Touch Grass consumes and displays the data.

data.name: Android Device Location (GPS)
data.description: On-device - FusedLocationProvider / GPS coordinates for weather and parks
data.reasonOutOfScope: Provided by Android OS and device hardware. We only control permission prompts and how coordinates are used.

data.name: auth + profile sync
data.description: Firebase Auth tokens, user profile, settings and streak sync via SyncWorker

threats.title: Firestore security rules too permissive
threats.description: Misconfigured rules let user A read/write user B profile, settings, or streak documents.
threats.mitigation: Rules require request.auth.uid == resource.data.uid; review in Firebase console.

threats.title: Stolen Firebase ID token replay
threats.description: Leaked ID token used from another client until expiry to access Firestore as victim.
threats.mitigation: Short token TTL; secure device storage; signOut on suspicious activity.

data.name: touch-grass weather + city
data.description: Open-Meteo forecast + Nominatim reverse-geocode for Touch Grass screen

data.name: lat/lon coordinates
data.description: GPS coordinates for OpenWeather, Overpass parks, and Touch Grass

diagrams.title: Level 1 BestieAYG Detailed DFD

data.name: BestieAYG App Sandbox (Android)
data.description: Trust boundary for com.bayg — UI, Room, SecurePrefs, biometric gate, API clients.

data.name: OpenWeather API
data.description: External - api.openweathermap.org (dashboard weather, BuildConfig API key)

data.name: Android Local Calendar
data.description: On-device - Android CalendarContract

data.name: Biometric Re-unlock Gate
data.description: BiometricUnlockGate + BiometricAuthManager. Re-unlock after Firebase session; Keystore-backed CryptoObject.

threats.title: Biometric gate skipped on emulator
threats.description: Emulator without enrolled biometrics may weaken re-unlock on dev builds.
threats.mitigation: Require BIOMETRIC_STRONG; fail closed if no biometric enrolled on production devices.

data.name: Firebase Session + Onboarding
data.description: Firebase Auth session state + OnboardingStore in SecurePrefs (encrypted). Gates dashboard access.

threats.title: Session persists after password change elsewhere
threats.description: Firebase session remains valid on device if password reset on another client.
threats.mitigation: Call auth.currentUser.reload() before sensitive actions; signOut on token refresh failure.

threats.title: Credentials captured on device before TLS
threats.description: Malware, accessibility overlay, or keyboard logger reads email/password while the user types in Auth UI, before Firebase SDK transmits over HTTPS.
threats.mitigation: Minimize credential lifetime in memory; rely on Firebase SDK for transport; educate users against sideloaded keyboards. NetworkSecurityConfig blocks cleartext.

data.name: email + password
data.description: Auth UI passes credentials to Authenticator.kt

data.name: auth request (HTTPS)
data.description: signIn/signUp to Firebase Auth over TLS

threats.title: MITM on Firebase Auth traffic
threats.description: Attacker with a user-installed CA (debug builds) or compromised network proxy could intercept Firebase Auth requests. Firebase is intentionally not certificate-pinned because Google rotates GTS certificates ~every 90 days.
threats.mitigation: Release builds reject user CAs (network_security_config.xml debug-overrides). Document accepted risk for Firebase; rely on TLS + system trust store in production.

data.name: ID token + profile
data.description: Firebase returns authenticated user + ID token

threats.title: ID token logged in debug builds
threats.description: Verbose logging of Firebase user or token in debug APK shared among team.
threats.mitigation: Strip sensitive logs in release; ProGuard/R8; no token in Log.d calls.

threats.title: Biometric data stored outside secure hardware
threats.description: Custom code stores fingerprint templates or routes biometrics outside the TEE. Android BiometricPrompt only returns success/failure — raw biometrics must never be persisted.
threats.mitigation: BiometricAuthManager uses BiometricPrompt + Keystore CryptoObject only. No biometric templates stored in SecurePrefs or Room.

data.name: store onboarding flag
data.description: OnboardingStore writes encrypted flag to SecurePrefs per UID

threats.title: Onboarding flag stored unencrypted
threats.description: OnboardingStore flag (onboarding_complete_<uid>) identifies account state. If stored in plaintext SharedPreferences, rooted device or backup could read it.
threats.mitigation: OnboardingStore uses SecurePrefs → EncryptedSharedPreferences with KeystoreManager master key.

threats.title: Pinned OpenWeather cert expires
threats.description: SPKI pin-set expiration (2027-01-01) or leaf rotation without pin update bricks weather card.
threats.mitigation: Refresh pins via scripts/compute-spki-pin.ps1 before expiration; monitor CI.

threats.title: Untrusted JSON displayed without sanitization
threats.description: noasaservice.lol response rendered on Touch Grass / dashboard without filtering.
threats.mitigation: NoAsAMessageSanitizer + length cap before Compose Text display.

data.name: touch-grass weather
data.description: Open-Meteo forecast for Touch Grass screen

data.name: GPS coordinates
data.description: Lat/lon from DeviceLocationProvider

threats.title: Precise GPS sent to OpenWeather
threats.description: Lat/lon in WeatherRepository query reveals user location to third party.
threats.mitigation: Location permission rationale in UI; coarse location option; OpenWeather privacy policy.

data.name: GPS coordinates
data.description: Lat/lon for Overpass park query

data.name: Fetch OpenWeather (Dashboard)
data.description: WeatherViewModel + WeatherRepository. Dashboard weather card via api.openweathermap.org (API key in BuildConfig).

threats.title: API key abuse after APK decompilation
threats.description: WeatherRepository reads BuildConfig.OPENWEATHER_API_KEY; attacker drains quota.
threats.mitigation: OpenWeather dashboard rate limits; monitor usage; document in threat model.

data.name: Fetch parks (Overpass)
data.description: NearestParkViewModel + TouchGrassActivity. Overpass API for nearby parks from GPS.

threats.title: Malicious park names from Overpass
threats.description: Compromised Overpass instance returns offensive or misleading OSM tag names.
threats.mitigation: Certificate pinning for overpass-api.de; display as plain text only (no WebView).

data.name: Instagram block + Touch Grass
data.description: InstagramBlockerService, UsageTracker, TouchGrassActivity. Blocks over-limit usage; Open-Meteo + Nominatim for touch-grass nudge.

threats.title: Instagram blocker bypassed via settings
threats.description: User disables Usage Access, force-stops InstagramBlockerService, or changes device date.
threats.mitigation: Re-prompt for PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS; foreground service restart; validate stats server-side if synced.

threats.title: Inflated usage stats to avoid block
threats.description: Attacker hooks UsageStatsManager or modifies Room block_events to under-report Instagram time.
threats.mitigation: Stats sourced from OS UsageStatsManager; Room is display cache only.

data.name: Dashboard + Stats UI
data.description: Dashboard.kt + Stats.kt. Aggregates weather, parks, usage, CBS benchmark, crashout events.

threats.title: Dashboard leaks aggregated sensitive context
threats.description: Screen shows usage vs NL average, calendar-driven crashout, GPS-derived location label.
threats.mitigation: FLAG_SECURE optional on stats; minimize fields; user consent for location.

data.name: Room DB (usage stats)
data.description: AppDatabase — block_events, streaks, user_settings. Written by UsageTracker and dashboard.

threats.title: Streak / block history tampered locally
threats.description: Attacker edits block_events or streaks rows in bayg.db to fake progress.
threats.mitigation: Firestore sync can reconcile; treat Room as cache; validate on push (SyncWorker).

data.name: Auth UI
data.description: Login/Register screens (AuthNavigation). Collects email + password from user.

threats.title: Weak password accepted at registration
threats.description: User submits password under 12 characters if client validation is bypassed.
threats.mitigation: Authenticator.MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH=12; Firebase ERROR_WEAK_PASSWORD mapped in UI.

data.name: Firebase Auth Client
data.description: Authenticator.kt — signIn/signUp via Firebase Auth SDK (HTTPS). Passwords never stored locally.

threats.title: Credential stuffing against Firebase Auth
threats.description: Attacker replays breached email/password pairs against Authenticator.signIn(). Successful login grants Firebase session until sign-out.
threats.mitigation: MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH=12 in Authenticator; Firebase Auth rate limits; email verification required before full access.

threats.title: Auth bypass via Frida hook
threats.description: Frida/Xposed hooks FirebaseAuth.getInstance().currentUser or isSignedIn to return a fake authenticated state and skip BiometricUnlockGate.
threats.mitigation: BiometricUnlockGate re-validates on resume; Firestore security rules require valid ID token; sensitive actions should re-check auth.getCurrentUser() at use time.

data.name: SecurePrefs + Room
data.description: SecurePrefs (EncryptedSharedPreferences + KeystoreManager) for onboarding flags. Room AppDatabase for local user profile cache.

threats.title: Room DB stored unencrypted
threats.description: bayg.db (Room) holds block_events, streaks, user_settings in plaintext SQLite. Rooted device or forensic image exposes Instagram usage patterns.
threats.mitigation: android:allowBackup=false; no credentials in Room; SQLCipher considered for future release.

threats.title: Database extracted via ADB backup
threats.description: Legacy adb backup or device transfer could copy app data including bayg.db if backup were enabled.
threats.mitigation: `allowBackup="false"` in AndroidManifest

data.name: Firebase (Auth + Firestore)
data.description: External - Google Firebase. Auth, email verification, Firestore profile/settings/streak sync.
data.reasonOutOfScope: External Google-managed cloud. Only auth calls and Firestore sync paths are in scope.

data.name: Open-Meteo / Nominatim
data.description: External - Touch Grass weather (Open-Meteo) and reverse geocode (Nominatim). Certificate pinned.
data.reasonOutOfScope: External open APIs. Only consumption in TouchGrassActivity is in scope.

data.name: Android Device Location (GPS)
data.description: On-device FusedLocationProvider / DeviceLocationProvider for weather and parks.
